name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
summary: Tiburon 开发、Electronic Arts 发行的体育模拟，2026 年 8 月 13 日上市。商店 AI 披露是 Steam 通用勾选句式：“生成式 AI 可能用于制作本作的预渲染或实时生成内容，且全部内容都是人工主导的创作结果”，没有点名任何学科；八个领域全部记为披露未说明，并标记为范围未说明。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.

sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 15 个主题（总数 192）；仅覆盖首页。

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Tiburon，发行商 Electronic Arts）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 192），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 2 次：第一次（07:56:50Z）返回的是每周补丁汇总、Steam Deck 销量报道、Nintendo Life 上的 Madden NFL 26（Switch 2）页、GameSpot 文章存档页与一段行业报告摘要，没有针对本作披露的内容，已按未采用登记；第二次（07:57:10Z）采用的检索登记 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源。唯一一篇行业文章讨论 DICE 对生成式 AI 的态度与 EA Sports 系列的 AI 争议（转引 Polygon 对 College Football 25 的报道），全文未提及本作或本作商店披露，只在站点导航里出现本作名称，按行业背景线索登记，不作为证据；Facebook 上“玩家质疑本作预告片配音是否为 AI”属玩家质疑且正文读不到，按线索登记。商店披露只有 EA 通用的两句勾选句式，用词是“may have been used”，未点名任何学科，因此八个领域一律不使用“已使用”，本条按“范围未说明”登记。检索范围仅限工具实际返回的内容，不能据此认定没有其他公开报道。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-03 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: The store disclosure for EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27 is Steam's generic checkbox wording: generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content and all such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process. No development discipline is named, so all eight areas are recorded as not addressed and the scope is flagged as unspecified.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Tiburon, publisher Electronic Arts) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 192); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 2 times: the first search returned a weekly patch-notes digest, a Steam Deck sales item, a Nintendo Life page for Madden NFL 26 on Switch 2, a GameSpot article archive page and an industry report summary, none of which covers this disclosure, and it is logged as a discarded attempt. The adopted search returned 6 results and 0 raw sources were read because the one industry article is about DICE on generative AI and about AI controversy across EA Sports titles, citing Polygon on College Football 25, and never mentions this game or its store disclosure beyond the site navigation; the Facebook post is player speculation about trailer voice-over whose body the relay could not read, so it is logged as a lead only. The disclosure is only these two sentences of generic EA wording, hedged with may have been used, naming no discipline, so no area is recorded as used and the scope is flagged as unspecified. That describes the search range and is not proof that no other coverage exists. The finding rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
